summary: The claim follows from the two supplied accepted predecessor facts with identical parameters, chain partition, rooted-tree support, height columns, weights, full normalizer, and original ambient halfspace depth. The cases exhaust all real gamma, and the stated partition and k quantifiers are preserved. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
